transforms.code:
assetPath = value['assetPath'] if value.has_key('assetPath') else None
	
	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': assetPath or 'none'}), 0)

filters = self.custom.filters
	if filters['assetId'] is None: return []
	notifications = filters['notifications']
	if not notifications.has_key('downtime') or notifications['downtime']['enabled'] == False : return []

	startDate = system.date.fromMillis(value['oeeTagInfo']['shiftStart']) if value['oeeTagInfo']['shiftStart'] else system.date.midnight(system.date.now())
	paramsDict = {'assetId': self.custom.assetInfo['assetId'], 'durationSecs': 0, 'showChanged': False, 'showDowntimeOnly': True, 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': system.date.now()}
	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.event.getAssetStateEvents(paramsDict))

if value['filters']['assetId'] is None: return []

	notifications = value['filters']['notifications']
	if not notifications.has_key('qualityChecks') or notifications['qualityChecks']['enabled'] == False : return []

	checks = {}

	for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value['checks']):
		if (row['assetId'] != value['filters']['assetId']) or row['auto']: continue
		if row['activeState'] or row['chkShtStateName'] == 'Missed':	#Any active state (Coming Due, Due, Overdue, In Progress, ...) plus recently Missed
			checks.setdefault(row['chkShtStateName'], []).append(row)
			
	return checks

notifications = self.view.custom.notifications
	
	tagInfo = self.view.custom.oeeTagInfo
	startDate = system.date.fromMillis(tagInfo['shiftStart']) if tagInfo['shiftStart'] else system.date.midnight(system.date.now())	
	
	instances = []
	
	if len(notifications['downtime']) > 0:
		msg = "1 Uncoded Downtime Event" if len(notifications['downtime']) == 1 else "%s Uncoded Downtime Events"%len(notifications['downtime'])
		navInfo = {
		  			"viewPath": 'kanoa/mes/asset/downtime/downtimeTable',
		  			"viewName": "Downtime Editor",
		  			"viewParams": {
									"assetId": self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetId,
									"assetPath": self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetPath,
									"endDate": system.date.now(),
									"options": {"minDurationMins": 0, "showAllStates": False,	"showChanged": 0, "showDurationSecs": False, "sortDateAsc": False},
									"startDate": startDate
									},
		  			"popup": True
				}
				
		instances.append({'value': {"bgColor": '-kcBlue-40', "icon": "material/warning", "iconColor": '--kcOrange-30', "navInfo": navInfo, "text": msg}})
	else:
		instances.append({'value': {"bgColor": '-kcBlue-40', "icon": "material/check", "iconColor": '--kcGreen-30', "navInfo": {}, "text": 'All Downtime Events Coded' }})

	
	for k,v in notifications['qualityChecks'].items():
		navInfo = {
		  			"viewPath": 'kanoa/qds/qdsDashboard',
		  			"viewName": 'Scheduled Checks',
		  			"viewParams": { 'value': {"assetPath": self.view.custom.assetInfo.assetPath, "chkShtStates": [k]}},
		  			"popup": False
				}
		
		if len(v) > 0:
			msg = "1 Quality Check %s"%k if len(v) == 1 else "%s Quality Checks %s"%(len(v), k)
			icon = 'material/fact_check' if k in ('Coming Due', 'Due', 'In Progress') else "material/warning"
			iconColor = '--kcRed-30' if k in ('Overdue', 'Missed') else '--kcOrange-30'
			instances.append({'value': {"bgColor": '-kcBlue-40', "icon": icon, "iconColor": iconColor, "navInfo": navInfo, "text": msg}})		
		
	for measure in notifications['measures']:
		msg = "%s measure Out-Of-Control signal detected: %s"%(measure['tagName'], ', '.join(measure['violations']))
		icon = "material/warning"
		iconColor = '--kcRed-30'
		navInfo = {
		  			"viewPath": 'kanoa/core/dbp/widgets/analytics/measureSPCAnalysis',
		  			"viewName": 'Measure SPC Analysis',
		  			"viewParams":{"tagPath": measure['tagPath']},
		  			"popup": True
				}
	
		instances.append({'value': {"bgColor": '-kcBlue-40', "icon": icon, "iconColor": iconColor, "navInfo": navInfo, "text": msg}})

	return instances
